articles.title: Up to Four-Year Outcomes of Single-Fraction Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Small Brain Metastases: A Competing-Risk Analysis.
articles.question: q1
quotes: Local control after 18 Gy SRS is poor in radioresistant brain metastases.

At 36 months, cumulative LTF was 62% (95% CI, 42%-77%) versus 31% (95% CI, 17%-46%) in radioresistant versus radiosensitive tumors (p = 0.011), whereas death without prior LTF was 19% (95% CI, 7%-34%) versus 46% (95% CI, 30%-61%) (p = 0.003).
articles.why_relevant_cs: Kohorta malých mozkových metastáz (medián objemu 0,3 cc) léčených jednorázovou SRS 18 Gy; RCC je zde zařazen mezi radiorezistentní nádory s horší lokální kontrolou. Týká se pacienta se solitárním uzlem v mozečku do 3 mm při metastatickém světlobuněčném RCC. Studie nesrovnává SRS se sledováním MR. Výsledek je v rozporu s kohortou Yaeh 2015 (lit-03); radiorezistentní skupina spojuje melanom, sarkom a RCC, údaj pro samotný RCC abstrakt neuvádí.

articles.title: Clinical Outcomes and Targeted Genomic Analysis of Renal Cell Carcinoma Brain Metastases Treated with Stereotactic Radiosurgery.
articles.question: q1
quotes: Durable local control of 83% was achieved at 12 mo after SRS, and 59% of lesions initially meeting the radiographic criteria for progression at 3-mo evaluation would be considered to represent pseudoprogression at 6-mo evaluation.
SRS provides durable in-field local control of BMs.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Největší uvedená kohorta mozkových metastáz RCC léčených SRS (91 pacientů, 212 lézí); udává lokální kontrolu a riziko pseudoprogrese, což je důležité pro hodnocení kontrolních MR u pacienta s podezřením na metastázu v mozečku.

articles.title: Control of brain metastases from radioresistant tumors treated by stereotactic radiosurgery.
articles.question: q1
quotes: The overall local control rate in the radioresistant cohort was 89.8 and 90.1 % in the non-radioresistant cohort.
There was no significant difference in local control of BM from radioresistant and non-radioresistant primary tumors treated with GKRS.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Srovnání lokální kontroly po Gamma Knife u radiorezistentních (včetně RCC) a ostatních nádorů; výsledek je v rozporu s kohortou Gruber 2026, proto obě uvádíme vedle sebe. Týká se otázky SRS u pacienta s metastatickým světlobuněčným RCC.

articles.title: Clinical Activity and Safety of Cabozantinib for Brain Metastases in Patients With Renal Cell Carcinoma.
articles.question: q2
quotes: The intracranial response rate was 55% (95% CI, 36%-73%) and 47% (95% CI, 33%-61%) in cohorts A and B, respectively.
In this cohort study, cabozantinib showed considerable intracranial activity and an acceptable safety profile in patients with RCC and brain metastases.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Retrospektivní mezinárodní kohorta (88 pacientů) s intrakraniální odpovědí na kabozantinib v jakékoli linii; pacient progreduje po nivolumabu+ipilimumabu a sunitinibu a kabozantinib je jednou z možností další linie.

articles.title: Cabozantinib in Renal Cell Carcinoma With Brain Metastases: Safety and Efficacy in a Real-World Population.
articles.question: q2
quotes: Patients were selected for the presence of BM before the start of treatment and for at least 1 previous tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) treatment regimen for metastatic disease.
All 5 patients treated with a combined systemic and brain-directed approach obtained intracranial disease control, without increased toxicity.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Malá reálná kohorta (12 pacientů) s kabozantinibem po předchozím TKI, což odpovídá pacientovi po sunitinibu; popisuje i kombinaci systémové a lokální léčby mozku.

articles.title: Impact of brain metastases on systemic renal cell carcinoma treatment outcomes: A systematic literature review.
articles.question: q2
quotes: The most evaluated systemic therapies were sunitinib, nivolumab, ipilimumab + nivolumab, cabozantinib and sorafenib.
There were no robust comparative data to guide systemic treatment selection.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Systematický přehled 62 publikací o systémové léčbě RCC s mozkovými metastázami; mezi nejčastěji hodnocenými léky nejsou everolimus, lenvatinib+everolimus ani tivozanib, tedy právě léčba, kterou pacient dostává nebo může dostat. Podklad pro vyznačení mezery v datech.

articles.title: Hepatitis and Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation in Everolimus-Treated Solid Tumor Patients: A Focus on HBV-Endemic Areas.
articles.question: q3
quotes: HBVr occurred in 11.36% (5/44) of HBsAg-positive patients without NUCs and 5.56% (2/36) with prophylaxis.
HBV screening and liver function monitoring are critical for patients with past or current HBV infection receiving everolimus, especially in endemic areas.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Retrospektivní kohorta (377 pacientů) léčených everolimem s údaji o reaktivaci HBV podle HBsAg; pacient je HBsAg pozitivní a nyní užívá everolimus. Reaktivace 11,36 % (n = 44, bez profylaxe) je nad pásmem 1-10 %, do kterého EASL 2025 (Tabulka 14) řadí inhibitory mTOR u HBsAg-pozitivních.

articles.title: Prevention of Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation With Lamivudine in a Patient With Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma Treated With Everolimus.
articles.question: q3
quotes: We present in this study the first case to our knowledge of a hepatitis B surface antigen-positive patient with metastatic renal cell carcinoma who has been successfully treated with prophylactic lamivudine and everolimus.
Hepatitis B surface antigen positivity may be found in up to 10% of cancer patients but should not be considered a contraindication to treatment with everolimus.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Kazuistika HBsAg pozitivního pacienta s metastatickým RCC léčeného everolimem s profylaxí lamivudinem; shoduje se s pacientem ve třech faktech (RCC, HBsAg pozitivita, everolimus).

articles.title: Progressive liver failure induced by everolimus for renal cell carcinoma in a 58-year-old male hepatitis B virus carrier.
articles.question: q3
quotes: He was admitted under a diagnosis of flare (acute exacerbation) of chronic B hepatitis due to HBV reactivation.
Antiviral prophylaxis must be taken into consideration before beginning immunosuppressive therapy such as everolimus in HBV carriers.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Kazuistika fatálního selhání jater při reaktivaci HBV u nosiče HBV léčeného everolimem pro metastatický RCC; týká se pacienta s HBsAg pozitivitou na everolimu.

articles.title: Fatal hepatitis B reactivation due to everolimus in metastatic breast cancer: case report and review of literature.
articles.question: q3
quotes: Here, we present an unfortunate case of fatal hepatitis B reactivation in a woman with metastatic breast cancer treated with everolimus and exemestane.

Clinicians and patients should be aware of this rare but fatal complication prior to everolimus use, and a detailed history, screening for hepatitis B and prophylactic antiviral treatment should be considered.
articles.why_relevant_cs: Kazuistika s přehledem literatury o fatální reaktivaci HBV při everolimu (karcinom prsu, ne RCC); doplňuje údaje k HBsAg pozitivitě pacienta na everolimu.
